scenarios.name: Apply a deck filter from card browser search
scenarios.reason: Final verification failed: "After the picker closes, the leftmost chip below the search field reads **All decks**."
scenarios.diagnosis: The app records the All decks choice but does not refresh the deck chip shown in the Card browser.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the Card browser’s active deck chip immediately after the deck picker selects All decks, and add a regression test that checks the chip changes from a named deck to All decks.
